name: agent-swarm
description: Agentic development harness prototype with planning, lanes, slices, and verification visibility.

scripts.demo:observability: npm run build && node scripts/run-observability-demo.mjs --driver fixture
scripts.demo:observability:codex: npm run build && node scripts/run-observability-demo.mjs --driver codex
scripts.demo:resume-context: npm run build && node scripts/run-resume-context-demo.mjs --driver fixture
scripts.demo:resume-context:codex: npm run build && node scripts/run-resume-context-demo.mjs --driver codex
scripts.demo:web-observability: npm run build && node scripts/run-web-observability-demo.mjs --driver fixture
scripts.demo:web-observability:codex: npm run build && node scripts/run-web-observability-demo.mjs --driver codex
scripts.demo:live-agent:serve: npm run build && node dist/cli.js serve --workspace .swarm-demo/live-agent-smoke --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4318
scripts.demo:live-agent:overseer: npm run build && cd .swarm-demo/live-agent-smoke && node ../../dist/cli.js orchestrate --actor live-overseer --driver codex --scenario live-agent-smoke
scripts.demo:live-agent:overseer:fixture: npm run build && cd .swarm-demo/live-agent-smoke && node ../../dist/cli.js orchestrate --actor live-overseer --driver fixture --scenario live-agent-smoke
scripts.demo:live-agent:overseer:execute: npm run build && cd .swarm-demo/live-agent-smoke && node ../../dist/cli.js orchestrate --actor live-overseer --driver codex --scenario live-agent-smoke --execute
scripts.demo:live-agent:overseer:execute:fixture: npm run build && cd .swarm-demo/live-agent-smoke && node ../../dist/cli.js orchestrate --actor live-overseer --driver fixture --scenario live-agent-smoke --execute
scripts.demo:live-agent:scripted: npm run build && node scripts/run-live-agent-scripted-demo.mjs --driver codex
